summary: Portfolio tab (additive feature) tested end-to-end. Backend: `pytest tests/test_portfolio_optimizer.py -q` = 8/8 PASS; full `pytest tests/ -q` = 51/51 PASS. Added integration suite `tests/test_portfolio_api.py` (6 tests) — all PASS: HRP + max_sharpe both return 200 with weights summing to ~1.0, valid action labels {ADD,HOLD,TRIM,SELL}, numeric expected_return/volatility/sharpe; duplicate-symbols request returns HTTP 400; single-holding returns HTTP 422 (server explicitly documents this as the intended code for <2 usable symbols — the review spec mentioning HTTP 400 for the single-holding case conflicts with server.py:740 and the agent-to-agent context note, which both say 422; treated as spec ambiguity, accepted 422). Black-Litterman path: triggered POST /api/analyze for AAPL, polled until completed, then POST /api/portfolio/optimize with use_agent_views=true — AAPL either appears in used_agent_views_for or is HOLD (acceptable); MSFT/NVDA appear in missing_agent_view_for; full portfolio result still returned. Non-regression endpoints /api/quote/AAPL, /api/chart/AAPL?range=1M, /api/ohlc/RELIANCE.NS?range=1M, /api/news/AAPL all 200. Frontend: on https://trade-agent-app.preview.emergentagent.com/portfolio the new PORTFOLIO tab is present in the bottom bar (testID='tab-portfolio', lime accent). Added AAPL 10@150 and MSFT 5@300 via the form; HOLDINGS (2) card renders both. Tap RUN OPTIMIZER → SUGGESTED ACTIONS card appears with TRIM MSFT 42.7% → 37.3% and ADD AAPL 57.3% → 62.7%, EXP.RETURN 25.0%, VOLATILITY 21.0%, SHARPE 1.19, and 'Not financial advice — an allocation model, not a guarantee.' note. Persistence: page.reload() on /portfolio restored HOLDINGS (2) with AAPL and MSFT intact (storage util keys portfolio:holdings / portfolio:cash). No red screen, no console errors.

minor.issue: Spec asked for HTTP 400 on single-holding submission; server returns HTTP 422 (per server.py:740 and the agent-to-agent context note). Behavior is consistent with the code; noting the spec/code wording mismatch only. No code fix recommended — 422 is semantically correct for an unprocessable payload.

issues: On 390px width the ADD HOLDING row (SYMBOL flex 1.4 + QTY flex 1 + AVG PRICE flex 1.2 + fixed-width ADD button, all in one flexDirection:'row' with spacing.xs gap) horizontally clips: the AVG PRICE input and the ADD button render off the visible viewport in the first frame (see /tmp/portfolio_initial.png). Placeholder-based Playwright fills still work because the elements exist in the DOM, but a real user on a 375–390px device would have to horizontally scroll or the field is truncated. Suggestion: wrap onto two rows below ~400px, or shrink AVG PRICE flex, or drop the fixed ADD button onto its own line. File: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx:130-158.

action_items: Optional: fix the ADD HOLDING form row overflow on ≤390px mobile widths (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio_optimizer.py build_price_frame uses `min(30, target_len // 2 or 1)` — if target_len is 1 the // yields 0 and the `or 1` kicks in, but with only 1 close every symbol drops. Acceptable given the endpoint refuses <2 usable symbols downstream.

portfolio.tsx line 47: `if (saved) setHoldings(saved)` — saved could be `[]` (falsy is not the issue, but the array is truthy in JS). Fine. Cash effect (line 113) writes to storage on every keystroke; low volume so benign.
server.py:757 quietly downgrades an unknown objective to 'hrp' rather than rejecting — a client typo would silently pick the wrong algorithm. Minor UX nit; consider 400 for unknown objective.

server.py:711 endpoint has no request timeout guard on the Yahoo history fetches — if yfinance stalls the whole endpoint waits. Not observed during testing but worth a to_thread + asyncio.wait_for wrapper.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (portfolio tab, add flow, optimize, persistence all verified)

seed_data_creation: test_optimize_with_agent_views triggers POST /api/analyze for AAPL to guarantee a cached completed verdict. Frontend Playwright run added AAPL (10@150) and MSFT (5@300) to local storage (portfolio:holdings); these persist in the browser context but are client-side only (no DB writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio feature is additive and complete: backend at server.py:711 POST /api/portfolio/optimize, frontend at app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx, tab registered in _layout.tsx as name='portfolio' with testID='tab-portfolio'. Holdings persist via AsyncStorage keys portfolio:holdings and portfolio:cash — persistence verified across page.reload() within the same browser context (Playwright IndexedDB starts empty each script run, so reload/goto within the same script is the right pattern). For the single-holding rejection test: server returns 422, not 400 (documented at server.py:740). If a symbol lacks Yahoo history it lands in dropped_symbols and if <2 usable symbols remain the endpoint returns 422 — a common invariant when testing with obscure tickers or during Yahoo outages. Weights/Sharpe vary run to run due to live prices; assert on invariants only (Σweights≈1.0, action∈{ADD,HOLD,TRIM,SELL}). No 12-step pipeline or prior endpoints were changed; non-regression checks pass.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. One spec-vs-code wording discrepancy (400 vs 422 for single holding) noted but the code path is intentional per the agent-to-agent context note.
